newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.425 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.425 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) fell by 85 basis points to 21.425 percent on Wednesday from 22.275 percent the previous day, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP fell 447.33 basis points to 21.4007 percent on Wednesday from 25.874 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE fell 250 basis points to 22.7500 percent on Wednesday from 25.25 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
